desc:
👊🏻Brawl Hard, 💸Stack Bounty, 🚨Rule the Block

UPDATES every other weekend!!

Game supports: CONSOLE, PC, MOBILE

Controls:
- M1 (Left Click) = LIGHT ATTACK: Attack other players.
- M2 (Right Click) = HEAVY ATTACK: Attack other players (ragdoll).
- G = TAKEDOWN: Perform special moves to takedown other players (ragdoll).
- Q = SHOVE: Shove a player and make them lose their balance (stun).
- F = STOMP: Step on a ragdolled player and deal damage.
- SPACE (Hold) + WASD = WEAVE: Weave to avoid attacks from other players.
- X = FINISHER: Press X near a player you damaged under 10HP to perform a finisher.

See controls for other devices in-game!

IMPORTANT: If you leave whilst In-Combat with 60HP or less you lose 50% of your Bounty.
